summary: Solowin Holdings filed a Form 6-K disclosing a November 5, 2026 securities purchase agreement with Gemini Asia Holdings Limited, an entity beneficially owned by Chairman/CEO Ling Ngai Lok, for a private placement of 1,000,000 unlisted Class B ordinary shares at US$1.20 each, gross US$1.2 million, equal to roughly 70% of the US$1.71 November 4 Nasdaq closing price of the Class A shares, closing on or around November 20, 2026. The audit committee and disinterested directors approved it, with Lok recusing himself, under Regulation S and home-country practice exemptions, without a shareholder meeting. Post-placement Lok may control approximately 95.17% of voting power, a related-party insider financing that is not a special situation but carries governance and overhang watch items.
